tagline: Securing People, Devices, and Data Everywhere
hero_kpi_rationale: The cybersecurity industry is constantly evolving, and patents represent critical innovation capacity. Fortinet holds 1,405 global patents, including 321 related to AI, demonstrating technological leadership in AI-security solutions.

kpis.name: Global Patents
kpis.explanation: Total number of patents held by the company worldwide
kpis.description: Patents are a key indicator of innovation and the company's ability to develop new technologies in the fields of cybersecurity and AI.
kpis.signal: Fortinet holds a significant patent portfolio, including 321 related to AI, demonstrating a strong commitment to technological innovation.

kpis.name: US Patents
kpis.explanation: Number of patents held by the company in the United States
kpis.description: US patents represent a major component of Fortinet's intellectual property portfolio.
kpis.signal: Fortinet holds 1,064 US patents, reflecting its strength in intellectual property within the key US market.

risks.title: Dependence on distribution channel
risks.score_rationale: Fortinet primarily sells through distributors and resellers, making its revenues dependent on their performance and potentially volatile based on market conditions and partner priorities.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The cybersecurity and secure networking market is highly competitive with numerous established and emerging players, leading to downward pricing pressure and potential market share loss.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and supply chain
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, tariffs, and supply chain disruptions can significantly impact the company's manufacturing, delivery, and costs.

risks.title: Dependence on technological innovation and R&D
risks.score_rationale: The company must continuously invest in R&D and innovate to remain competitive amid market developments, including networking-security convergence and cloud and AI solutions.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data security risks
risks.score_rationale: As a security provider, Fortinet is an attractive target for cyberattacks. Any compromise of its systems or customer data would have a significant negative impact on its reputation, legal liability, and business operations.

risks.title: Regulatory risks and compliance
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a strict regulatory environment regarding data protection, cybersecurity, technology export, and AI, resulting in significant compliance costs and risks of penalties.

risks.title: Revenue volatility and financing capacity
risks.score_rationale: Complex enterprise sales, seasonal variations, and macroeconomic conditions can create revenue volatility affecting financial predictability and access to financing.

ai_positioning.summary: Fortinet explicitly positions AI at the core of its strategy. The company has developed FortiAI, an AI platform integrated into its security architecture. FortiAI-Assist uses generative and agentic AI to support SOC/NOC teams. FortiAI-Protect addresses AI-related threats. The company holds 321 AI-related patents and emphasizes AI as a key element of its networking-security convergence.
evidence: FortiAI provides a dual-layer defense through the AI for Security and Security for AI framework
321 AI-related patents held as of December 31, 2025
FortiAI-Assist uses generative and agentic AI for security operations
FortiAI-Protect uses AI/ML to detect AI-driven threats and zero-day attacks
FortiAI-SecureAI protects AI infrastructure, LLMs, APIs, and prevents data leaks
